facts.claim: Mein Schiff 2 (TUI Cruises): Entered service 2019; 111,500 GT; 2894 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Mein Schiff 1 class.

Two ships have been named Mein Schiff 2,Mein Schiff 2 (2011) launched in 1997, served under this name between 2011 and 2018
Mein Schiff 2 (2018) launched in 2018
